item.title: Jerusalem Daily: US to send $2.8BN worth of weapons to Israel
item.description: A 15-year-old boy was killed in a double-tap strike while trying to save a paramedic.

item.description: Stockholm says Iran-backed groups are plotting against 'Jewish and Israeli interests' in the country.

item.title: Ex-Trump ally Marjorie Taylor Greene says war on Iran must ‘stop’
item.description: Former Republican Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene slammed US President Donald Trump’s war on Iran.

item.description: Two people were killed in the assault on Gaza City - a paramedic and a 15-year-old boy returning from school.

item.description: Amnesty International says Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity during the 2022-23 protests.

item.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
item.description: A wrecked air force plane and destroyed buildings are among the images obtained by the BBC's partner CBS News.

item.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
item.description: Some 10 families had reportedly been living in the six-storey building in Gaza City that was hit by an Israeli strike last year.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
item.description: The Houthis deny targeting the Islamic holy city after the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen accuses them of a "disgraceful act".

item.title: Charlie Kirk's family alleges 'stunning failures' by Utah officials led to his shooting
item.description: The conservative activist was speaking to a crowd of thousands on the university campus when he was shot and killed by a gunman positioned on a roof.
